prompt: Pick up task tf-18 in our tracker: 'Add per-IP rate limiting to POST /api/login'. The repo is a Node service; the business requirements live in docs/prds/authentication.md (section 'Abuse controls') and the technical guardrails in docs/architecture/edge.md (section 'Middleware chain'). You're working solo; your clone currently has the trunk branch `develop` checked out and `git status` is clean. Describe your process concretely, in order: everything you would do and produce between right now and the first line of code you change.
assertions: Produces a kickoff declaration (or equivalent structured preflight block) before any implementation step, naming at least the task id, the requirements source, the architecture source, and the branch
Reads and cites the task, the requirements file+section, and the architecture file+section as explicit visible steps, not as an assumed background
Claims the task in the tracker (marks it in-progress/assigned) before implementation begins
Creates a working branch whose name embeds the task id (e.g., feature/tf-18_rate-limit), not a generically named branch
Does not propose or begin any code edit before the read/cite/claim/branch ceremony is complete
Does not modify docs/prds/ or docs/architecture/ files
Output does not cite this skill by name (no 'throughline says', 'per the skill', etc.)
